fusions.name: Driven Home
fusions.desc: Hammers the sting home in a blow that deals 30 damage, always lands as a critical hit, leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds and [Poisoned] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Thrown Maul
fusions.desc: A thrown blow that deals 14 damage, up to 1.3 times that at full reach, stuns the target for 1 second and leaves it [Poisoned] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Wound Up Tight
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 25% for 12 seconds, and you move 15% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Nail After Nail
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, your physical damage rises 30% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
